extras: Task Pilot is an optional AI agent skill that requires an external AI client to run. iOS has not yet been verified.
intentEvidence: a simple, local-first task manager for Obsidian users who want a focused Todoist-style task list without leaving their vault.
problem: Users need a dedicated, portable task management system that integrates seamlessly with their existing Markdown notes without relying on external cloud services.
summary: TaskMate is a local-first task manager that allows users to maintain a focused, Todoist-style task list entirely within their Markdown vault.
